newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian peso closes 1.03 lower at 995.22.
newsitem.headline: Colombian peso closes 1.03 lower at 995.22.

text.p: Colombia's peso closed 1.03 lower at 995.22 after breeching the floor of the central bank's daily floating rate exchange band, interbank dealers said.
They said the peso hit an intra-day low of 996.30 early in the day -- 1.08 pesos below the floor of the trading band -- forcing the central bank to buy small amounts of dollars to lift it back up.
The peso's losses stemmed from dollar-buying by private sector businesses shifting some of their investment portfolios into foreign currency, dealers said.

They reported 193 trades for a total of $110 million and said an ample supply of dollars was seen lending support to the peso in trading later this week despite the downward pressure the local curerency fell under Monday.
